headwords.text: To dream of a procession, denotes that alarming fears will possess you relative to the fulfilment of expectations. If it be a funeral procession, sorrow is fast approaching, and will throw a shadow around pleasures. To see or participate in a torch-light procession, denotes that you will engage in gaieties which will detract from your real merit.
headwords.note: 새 상징 `procession`(행렬). 기존 `king`의 「임금의 행렬을 봄」은 왕의 행렬이라는 좁은 그림이고 판별어일 뿐 별칭이 아니라 안 겹친다

headwords.text: To dream of profanity, denotes that you will cultivate those traits which render you coarse and unfeeling toward your fellow man. To dream that others use profanity, is a sign that you will be injured in some way, and probably insulted also.
headwords.note: 기존 상징 `blasphemy`(신성모독)에 더한다 — "profanity"가 이미 그 영어 별칭이다

headwords.text: To dream of profits, brings success in your immediate future.
headwords.note: 새 상징 `gain`(이득). 각주 [175]는 「Gain 항목 참고」이지만 그 표제어는 아직 안 뽑혔다(원문이 순수 알파벳순이 아니다) — 지금은 새로 만들고, 나중에 Gain을 만나면 합친다

headwords.text: To dream of promenading, foretells that you will engage in energetic and profitable pursuits. To see others promenading, signifies that you will have rivals in your pursuits.
To dream that you own vast property, denotes that you will be successful in affairs, and gain friendships.
headwords.note: 기존 상징 `wealth`(재산)에 더한다 — "property"가 이미 그 영어 별칭이다. 각주 [176]은 「Wealth 항목 참고」다

headwords.text: To dream that you are in the company of a prostitute, denotes that you will incur the righteous scorn of friends for some ill-mannered conduct. For a young woman to dream of a prostitute, foretells that she will deceive her lover as to her purity or candor. This dream to a married woman brings suspicion of her husband and consequent quarrels.
headwords.note: 기존 상징 `harlot`(몸 파는 이)에 더한다. 첫 문장은 기존 「몸 파는 이와 어울림」(밀러 Harlot)과 같은 그림이라 인용을 포갠다. 나머지 둘(처녀·기혼 여성)만 새 문맥. 각주 [177]은 「Harlot 항목 참고」다
